Key features:</p><p style="line-height:1.8;margin-bottom:1rem">| Feature | Description |
<p style="line-height:1.8;margin-bottom:1rem">|---------|-------------|</p>
<p style="line-height:1.8;margin-bottom:1rem">| <strong style="font-weight:700">SEO Scan</strong> | Checks keyword density, meta tags, backlinks, & SERP performance |</p>
<p style="line-height:1.8;margin-bottom:1rem">| <strong style="font-weight:700">Accessibility Audit</strong> | WCAG 2.1 compliance, ARIA roles, color contrast |</p>
<p style="line-height:1.8;margin-bottom:1rem">| <strong style="font-weight:700">Performance Analysis</strong> | Core Web Vitals, page speed, caching |</p>
<p style="line-height:1.8;margin-bottom:1rem">| <strong style="font-weight:700">Security Scan</strong> | SSL validation, mixed content, outdated dependencies |</p>
<p style="line-height:1.8;margin-bottom:1rem">| <strong style="font-weight:700">Competitor Benchmarking</strong> | Side‑by‑side comparison with up to 5 rivals |</p><p style="line-height:1.8;margin-bottom:1rem">The platform’s intuitive dashboard aggregates all insights into a single, searchable report, making it easier than ever for developers, marketers, and product managers to collaborate.</p><p style="line-height:1.8;margin-bottom:1rem">---</p><p style="line-height:1.8;margin-bottom:1rem"></p>
<h2 style="font-size:1.4rem;font-weight:700;color:#6d28d9;margin:2rem 0 0.5rem;border-bottom:2px solid #6d28d922;padding-bottom:0.4rem">Why Choose Auditee.site Over Traditional Tools?</h2></p><p style="line-height:1.8;margin-bottom:1rem">
<p style="line-height:1.8;margin-bottom:1rem">While tools like Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, and SEMrush are industry staples, Auditee.site offers some distinct advantages:</p><p style="line-height:1.8;margin-bottom:1rem"><li style="margin:0.4rem 0 0.4rem 1.5rem;list-style:disc"><strong style="font-weight:700">All‑in‑One Solution:</strong> One subscription, everything you need—no need to juggle multiple dashboards.</li></p>
<li style="margin:0.4rem 0 0.4rem 1.5rem;list-style:disc"><strong style="font-weight:700">Real‑Time Machine Learning:</strong> Continuous learning from each crawl means more accurate results over time.</li>
<li style="margin:0.4rem 0 0.4rem 1.5rem;list-style:disc"><strong style="font-weight:700">Actionable Recommendations:</strong> Beyond flags, it suggests fixes with estimated effort and impact.</li>
<li style="margin:0.4rem 0 0.4rem 1.5rem;list-style:disc"><strong style="font-weight:700">Scoped Audits:</strong> Zero‑partial scans—opt into precisely the sections you care about.</li>
<li style="margin:0.4rem 0 0.4rem 1.5rem;list-style:disc"><strong style="font-weight:700">Affordable Pricing:</strong> Most auditors sit at $49/month for high‑traffic sites; Auditee.site starts at $29/month with a 30‑day free trial.</li></p><p style="line-height:1.8;margin-bottom:1rem"><strong style="font-weight:700">Pro/Con Comparison</strong></p><p style="line-height:1.8;margin-bottom:1rem">| Tool | Pros | Cons |
<p style="line-height:1.8;margin-bottom:1rem">|------|------|------|</p>
<p style="line-height:1.8;margin-bottom:1rem">| Auditee.site | All‑in‑One, AI‑driven, real‑time updates, affordable | Limited integrations vs. giants |</p>
<p style="line-height:1.8;margin-bottom:1rem">| Ahrefs | Deep backlink analysis | No performance or accessibility checks |</p>
<p style="line-height:1.8;margin-bottom:1rem">| Screaming Frog | Desktop crawler, free tier | Manual setup, no AI insights |</p>
<p style="line-height:1.8;margin-bottom:1rem">| SEMrush | SEO + PPC tools | Expensive, not always accurate on tech heavy sites |</p><p style="line-height:1.8;margin-bottom:1rem">---</p><p style="line-height:1.8;margin-bottom:1rem"></p>
<h2 style="font-size:1.4rem;font-weight:700;color:#6d28d9;margin:2rem 0 0.5rem;border-bottom:2px solid #6d28d922;padding-bottom:0.4rem">Step‑by‑Step Setup Guide</h2></p><p style="line-height:1.8;margin-bottom:1rem">
<p style="line-height:1.8;margin-bottom:1rem">Follow these simple steps to get started with Auditee.site in under 10 minutes.</p><p style="line-height:1.8;margin-bottom:1rem"><h3 style="font-size:1.15rem;font-weight:600;margin:1.5rem 0 0.4rem">1. Create an Account</h3></p><p style="line-height:1.8;margin-bottom:1rem"><li style="margin:0.4rem 0 0.4rem 1.5rem;list-style:disc">Visit the website and click <strong style="font-weight:700">Sign Up</strong>.</li></p>
<li style="margin:0.4rem 0 0.4rem 1.5rem;list-style:disc">Use either email or Google OAuth to register.</li>
<li style="margin:0.4rem 0 0.4rem 1.5rem;list-style:disc">Verify your email—audit logs are protected.</li></p><p style="line-height:1.8;margin-bottom:1rem"><h3 style="font-size:1.15rem;font-weight:600;margin:1.5rem 0 0.4rem">2. Add Your Website</h3></p><p style="line-height:1.8;margin-bottom:1rem"><li style="margin:0.4rem 0 0.4rem 1.5rem;list-style:disc">In the dashboard, click <strong style="font-weight:700">Add Site</strong>.</li>
<li style="margin:0.4rem 0 0.4rem 1.5rem;list-style:disc">Enter your domain, choose the crawl depth (default 5), and give it a name.</li></p><p style="line-height:1.8;margin-bottom:1rem"><h3 style="font-size:1.15rem;font-weight:600;margin:1.5rem 0 0.4rem">3. Configure Audit Scope</h3></p><p style="line-height:1.8;margin-bottom:1rem"><li style="margin:0.4rem 0 0.4rem 1.5rem;list-style:disc">Select the modules you want: SEO, Accessibility, Performance, Security, Competitor.</li>
<li style="margin:0.4rem 0 0.4rem 1.5rem;list-style:disc">Optional: set a custom sitemap for focused crawling.</li></p><p style="line-height:1.8;margin-bottom:1rem"><h3 style="font-size:1.15rem;font-weight:600;margin:1.5rem 0 0.4rem">4. Run Your First Crawl</h3></p><p style="line-height:1.8;margin-bottom:1rem"><li style="margin:0.4rem 0 0.4rem 1.5rem;list-style:disc">Hit <strong style="font-weight:700">Start Crawl</strong>.</li>
<li style="margin:0.4rem 0 0.4rem 1.5rem;list-style:disc">The system will immediately report “Crawling in progress…”.</li>
<li style="margin:0.4rem 0 0.4rem 1.5rem;list-style:disc">Real‑time status updates help you monitor progress.</li></p><p style="line-height:1.8;margin-bottom:1rem"><h3 style="font-size:1.15rem;font-weight:600;margin:1.5rem 0 0.4rem">5. Review the Dashboard</h3></p><p style="line-height:1.8;margin-bottom:1rem"><li style="margin:0.4rem 0 0.4rem 1.5rem;list-style:disc">Once the crawl finishes, the results populate under <strong style="font-weight:700">Reports</strong>.</li>
<li style="margin:0.4rem 0 0.4rem 1.5rem;list-style:disc">Hover over metrics to see tooltips and recommendations.</li></p><p style="line-height:1.8;margin-bottom:1rem"><h3 style="font-size:1.15rem;font-weight:600;margin:1.5rem 0 0.4rem">6. Export & Share</h3></p><p style="line-height:1.8;margin-bottom:1rem"><li style="margin:0.4rem 0 0.4rem 1.5rem;list-style:disc">Click <strong style="font-weight:700">Export</strong> to download PDF or CSV.</li>
<li style="margin:0.4rem 0 0.4rem 1.5rem;list-style:disc">Use the “Share” link for collaboration with your team.</li></p><p style="line-height:1.8;margin-bottom:1rem">---</p><p style="line-height:1.8;margin-bottom:1rem">
<h2 style="font-size:1.4rem;font-weight:700;color:#6d28d9;margin:2rem 0 0.5rem;border-bottom:2px solid #6d28d922;padding-bottom:0.4rem">Customizing Your Audit Reports</h2></p><p style="line-height:1.8;margin-bottom:1rem">
<p style="line-height:1.8;margin-bottom:1rem">Easily adapt the output to suit stakeholders’ needs.</p><p style="line-height:1.8;margin-bottom:1rem"><h3 style="font-size:1.15rem;font-weight:600;margin:1.5rem 0 0.4rem">1. Filter by Issue Severity</h3></p><p style="line-height:1.8;margin-bottom:1rem"><li style="margin:0.4rem 0 0.4rem 1.5rem;list-style:disc">Prioritize critical issues (e.g., broken links, missing alt tags) by setting threshold levels.</li></p><p style="line-height:1.8;margin-bottom:1rem"><h3 style="font-size:1.15rem;font-weight:600;margin:1.5rem 0 0.4rem">2. Add Branding</h3></p><p style="line-height:1.8;margin-bottom:1rem"><li style="margin:0.4rem 0 0.4rem 1.5rem;list-style:disc">Upload your logo and select color schemes to match your brand identity.</li></p><p style="line-height:1.8;margin-bottom:1rem"><h3 style="font-size:1.15rem;font-weight:600;margin:1.5rem 0 0.4rem">3. Enable Auto‑Scheduling</h3></p><p style="line-height:1.8;margin-bottom:1rem"><li style="margin:0.4rem 0 0.4rem 1.5rem;list-style:disc">Set up a weekly/monthly audit with the scheduler under <strong style="font-weight:700">Automations</strong>.</li></p>
<li style="margin:0.4rem 0 0.4rem 1.5rem;list-style:disc">Receive email notifications when new reports are ready.</li></p><p style="line-height:1.8;margin-bottom:1rem"><h3 style="font-size:1.15rem;font-weight:600;margin:1.5rem 0 0.4rem">4. Dashboards for Different Audiences</h3></p><p style="line-height:1.8;margin-bottom:1rem"><li style="margin:0.4rem 0 0.4rem 1.5rem;list-style:disc">Create separate views: <em>Dev Dashboard</em> (performance, security) vs. <em>Marketing Dashboard</em> (SEO, CRO).</li></p><p style="line-height:1.8;margin-bottom:1rem">---</p><p style="line-height:1.8;margin-bottom:1rem">

<p style="line-height:1.8;margin-bottom:1rem">| <strong style="font-weight:700">Mobile‑Friendly Score</strong> | Mobile traffic is ~70% of all web visits | Real‑time alerts on viewport issues |</p>
<p style="line-height:1.8;margin-bottom:1rem">| <strong style="font-weight:700">Page Load Time (seconds)</strong> | Direct correlation with bounce rate | Snapshot of critical resource delays |</p>
<p style="line-height:1.8;margin-bottom:1rem">| <strong style="font-weight:700">WCAG 2.1 Compliance Level</strong> | Legal requirement & broader audience | Automated label suggestions |</p>
<p style="line-height:1.8;margin-bottom:1rem">| <strong style="font-weight:700">Backlink Quality Score</strong> | SEO authority, spam risk | Visual timeline of backlinks gained/lost |</p>
<p style="line-height:1.8;margin-bottom:1rem">| <strong style="font-weight:700">Core Web Vitals</strong> | Google ranking factor | Immediate suggestions: lazy load, font preloading |</p><p style="line-height:1.8;margin-bottom:1rem"><strong style="font-weight:700">Tip:</strong> Use the “Impact Calculator” feature to quantify the benefit of fixing an issue (e.g., a 0.5 s load time improvement could boost conversions by ~2%).</p><p style="line-height:1.8;margin-bottom:1rem">---</p><p style="line-height:1.8;margin-bottom:1rem"></p>
